sets.name: Millennium Prize Problems
sets.description: Seven problems selected by the Clay Mathematics Institute in 2000, each with a $1,000,000 prize for solution.

sets.name: Hilbert's 23 Problems
sets.description: David Hilbert's list of 23 unsolved problems presented at the International Congress of Mathematicians in Paris in 1900.

sets.name: Ben Green's 100 Open Problems
sets.description: A collection of 100 open problems in additive combinatorics and related areas, compiled by Ben Green.

sets.name: DARPA's 23 Mathematical Challenges
sets.description: Mathematical challenges identified by DARPA to drive fundamental research in mathematics.

sets.name: Smale's Problems
sets.description: Steve Smale's list of mathematical problems for the 21st century.

sets.name: Landau's Problems
sets.description: Four basic problems about prime numbers posed by Edmund Landau at the 1912 International Congress of Mathematicians.

sets.name: Hardy-Littlewood Conjectures
sets.description: A collection of fundamental conjectures on prime numbers, Goldbach-type problems, and Waring's problem from the "Partitio Numerorum" papers (1919-1923) by G.H. Hardy and J.E. Littlewood.

sets.name: Erdős Problems
sets.description: A collection of open problems posed by Paul Erdős, one of the most prolific mathematicians of the 20th century. These problems span combinatorics, number theory, graph theory, and analysis.

sets.name: Richard Guy - A: Prime Numbers
sets.description: Problems from Chapter A (Prime Numbers) of Richard Guy's "Unsolved Problems in Number Theory", a comprehensive collection of open questions in prime number theory.

sets.name: Kourovka Notebook - New Problems, Issue 21
sets.description: New group theory problems from the 21st issue of the Kourovka Notebook, published in 2026.

sets.name: Kirby's Problems in Low-Dimensional Topology
sets.description: Problems from Kirby-style notes on low-dimensional topology, including knot theory, 3-manifolds, 4-manifolds, and related invariants.

sets.name: OpenGarden
sets.description: Problems imported from the Open Problem Garden collection, using source statements, discussion notes, and subject metadata.

policy.open_status_source: detail page when available; browse index fallback otherwise
policy.erdos_exclusion: membership in UnsolvedMath set 8 or EP-{number} source id
policy.deduplication: exact normalized title-plus-statement fingerprint plus conservative normalized-title aliases; the canonical record is chosen by source-consistency quality
policy.source_id_collisions: Distinct browse-index titles sharing one source id are preserved as index-collision records; they require statement recovery because the shared detail URL is ambiguous
policy.detail_storage: extracted Next.js problem payload plus source page SHA-256; raw detail HTML is not redistributed
